user.title: Connect or renew an Incus server

ssh.title: Connect to your Incus server
ssh.description: Leave the display name blank to use the server hostname automatically. Enter a host account that can administer Incus, directly or through sudo. SSH credentials are used only during setup and are not saved. This connection grants Home Assistant Incus management access. Projects: * for all, or comma-separated names. Automatic HTTPS setup enables Incus on all host interfaces at the selected API port if no listener exists. Existing listeners and firewall rules are left unchanged. Host monitoring installs a dedicated metrics-only SSH public key in this account. The matching key is stored privately in Home Assistant. Python 3 and writable ~/.ssh/authorized_keys are required. No SSH password is saved.

data.name: Display name (optional; detected from server)
data.enable_https: Enable Incus HTTPS automatically if disabled
data.host_metrics: Set up whole-server CPU, memory and filesystem monitoring

confirm_host.title: Verify SSH server identity

failed.title: Server setup did not complete
failed.description:
{reason}

Continue to try again. SSH credentials have been discarded.

token.title: Enroll with an existing trust token
token.description: Leave the display name blank to use the server hostname automatically. The token enrolls a new Home Assistant client certificate. It is consumed during setup and is not saved.

menu_options.connection: Change address, port, or projects (keep existing trust)
menu_options.renew_trust: Renew certificate trust using SSH or a one-time token
menu_options.host_metrics: Set up or disable whole-server metrics

connection.title: Update server connection
connection.description: Connect to the same Incus server using its existing pinned certificate. The connection and selected projects are checked before saving. Devices, entities, and server order are preserved. Use Renew certificate trust if the server certificate has changed.

host_metrics.title: Whole-server monitoring
host_metrics.description: Read this host’s total CPU, RAM and local filesystem usage independently of Incus. Setup adds a dedicated SSH key restricted to metrics and removal of that key. No password is stored. Python 3 and writable ~/.ssh/authorized_keys are required. Uncheck Enable to remove monitoring; authentication fields are then unused. Each cluster member needs its own setup.

error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL or port.
error.ssh_unreachable: Could not read the server SSH host key. Check the address, SSH port, and network access.
error.token_failed: Enrollment failed. Check the token, address, port, and projects. Tokens are single-use; generate another if already consumed.
error.connection_failed: Could not validate the connection and projects using existing trust. Check the address, port, projects, and server availability. For a changed certificate, use Renew certificate trust.

abort.already_configured: This Incus server or cluster is already configured.

init.title: Dashboard refresh interval
init.description: Applies to all server polling and host metrics. The same setting is available on the dashboard.
